title: Min Cost Climbing Stairs
statement: Start on stair 0 or stair 1. Pay the cost printed on each stair when leaving it, then advance one or two steps. Find the least total cost to reach the landing just beyond the last stair.

examples.explanation: Start on stair 1 and leave it for the landing.

hints: Conceptual: There is no fee at the landing.
Directional: The landing can be reached from either of the last two stairs.
Implementation: For each position from 2 onward, compare the cost of reaching and leaving each of the previous two positions.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time and O(1) extra space.
